'''Space Station Trenchant''' was located in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was the scene of [[Mission to Trenchant space station|the battle]] between [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Grievous's victory ensured that it was he who became [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==The ship/space station==
The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] itself contained many artifacts and displayed animals as well as rare living specimens in [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] tanks. The space station had many other relics as well, including various weaponry. There were also collections of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. Suits of armor, antique vases, ancient [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], skeletons, statues of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and globes were present as well.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' first located Space Station Trenchant in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SWTCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref>
